themes.title: Elite Theory
themes.one_line: Who actually decides, and how that differs from the story on the news.
themes.guardrail: Analysis of power, not a hunt for bloodlines.
themes.why: The envelope is often an elite consensus posing as weather. Name the machinery.

resources.title: The Power Elite
resources.one_line: The mid-century map of interlocking civic, military, and economic command.

themes.title: Noblesse Oblige
themes.one_line: Privilege and high status carry a duty to act responsibly toward those with less of both.
themes.guardrail: An alternative welfare grammar. Duty, not blood.
themes.why: The envelope insists the current welfare model is the only welfare model.

resources.title: The Revolt of the Elites and the Betrayal of Democracy
resources.one_line: Contrasts rooted aristocracies with cosmopolitan meritocrats who treat privilege as purely earned.
resources.guardrail: Historian and social critic. Class and place, not folk-biology.

themes.title: Cyclical History
themes.one_line: Civilisations do not progress forever in a straight line. They thicken, peak, decay, and start again.
themes.guardrail: Analysis of history. Cycles of institutions, not races.
themes.why: Challenges the official story of endless accumulating progress.

resources.title: The Prophets of Doom
resources.one_line: A survey of thinkers who reject the endless-progress view of history.
resources.guardrail: Read as a map of cyclical theories. Parvini is a source, not a mascot.

themes.title: Esotericism
themes.one_line: Challenge your preconceptions and update your priors.
themes.guardrail: Hidden knowledge as method — psychogeography, mythic cities, avant-garde. Not a soil-cult and not an initiation fee.
themes.why: The official page treats only the approved surface as real. Some English writing treats the city as a palimpsest.

resources.title: Lud Heat
resources.one_line: Hawksmoor churches, ley lines, and the city's buried geometry — infrastructure as a haunted diagram.
resources.guardrail: Psychogeography. English soil here is a map, not a race-myth.

resources.title: Albion: The Origins of the English Imagination
resources.one_line: London as a living, cyclical organism — history and memory repeating through the stones of the street.
resources.guardrail: Psychogeography and mythic topography. Not occult nationalism.

themes.title: Advanced Technology
themes.one_line: Not possible British futures. Destiny, if a country will still build machines.
themes.guardrail: Grounded but hyper-ambitious. Labs and launch, not gadget sermons.
themes.why: No Anglofuturism without the future. Energy, compute, and orbit are the floor.

resources.title: Planetocracy
resources.one_line: A British register of space as a working frontier, not a NASA costume.
resources.guardrail: Space as industry and research. Not empire-cosplay.

themes.title: Anglofuturism
themes.one_line: Britain dreams of itself — and is allowed to want altitude.
themes.guardrail: A deep idea of time, place, and meaning. Not a party and not a folk-religion.
themes.why: Foundational public workshops: the essay that named the mood, the podcast, the adjacent stacks.

resources.title: Anglofuturism Blast
resources.one_line: A running workshop in the same key: Britain as a country that can still want things.
resources.guardrail: One of the originators. Quote, do not enlist.

resources.title: Anglofuturism Podcast
resources.one_line: The most public workshop the movement has. Housing, energy, spaceports, state capacity.
resources.guardrail: Popularisers, not owners of the word.

resources.title: This is Anglofuturism
resources.one_line: An early primer: the word, the mood, and why the official page ran out.
resources.guardrail: Early adopter essay. A primer, not a membership mark.

resources.title: Anglofuturism Digital Trust Network
resources.one_line: Digital serfdom or a liberty-first self-sovereign ID.
resources.guardrail: Pro-technology, pro-privacy. Not a kit for a parallel state.

themes.title: The Full Stack
themes.one_line: Substacks worth keeping on the desk — ordained or not.
themes.guardrail: Recommendations, not endorsements. Ideas, not a mailing-list church.
themes.why: Ideas matter a great deal here. This is a shelf, not a canon.

resources.title: Roots & Wings
resources.one_line: Against the manners of Western decline — education, authority, and the grown-up.
resources.guardrail: Sociologist. Read the argument, not the brand.

resources.title: Alasdair's Substack
resources.one_line: Institutional and political reform as a craft problem.
resources.guardrail: New thinking. Not a station officer.

resources.title: Domesday Foundation
resources.one_line: A possible branching future — building the next regime as a thought-experiment.
resources.guardrail: A branching future, not a putsch manual. Recommendation, not enlistment.

resources.title: Academy of Ideas
resources.one_line: When we said ideas matter, we meant it.
resources.guardrail: A factory of arguments. Not our membership desk.

themes.title: Alt-Governance
themes.one_line: If there is a new way, try it — and it had better work.
themes.guardrail: Evolution, not revolution. Civic systems, not a coup kit and not a party.
themes.why: Systems of governance for the information age, filed as experiments rather than anointings.

resources.title: Networked Commons Governance
resources.one_line: Governance sketched for the information age.
resources.guardrail: A proposal. Evolution, not a script.

resources.title: The Network State
resources.one_line: A cloud-first account of how a polity might start.
